tasks.label: build rhythm game
tasks.command: mkdir -p ./build/Debug && g++ -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wformat=2 -Wcast-align -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wnull-dereference -g3 -O0 -c src/beatmap.cpp -o ./build/Debug/beatmap.o && g++ -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wformat=2 -Wcast-align -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wnull-dereference -g3 -O0 -c src/main.cpp -o ./build/Debug/main.o && g++ -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wformat=2 -Wcast-align -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wnull-dereference -g3 -O0 -c src/song.cpp -o ./build/Debug/song.o && g++ -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wformat=2 -Wcast-align -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wnull-dereference -g3 -O0 ./build/Debug/beatmap.o ./build/Debug/main.o ./build/Debug/song.o -o ./build/Debug/outDebug -lncurses -lsfml-audio -lsfml-system
